title: cert-manager CRDs still carry a removed API version

detection.reason: the CRDs' version LIST is projected; which version each resource is STORED at in etcd is not, so a clean result here means the CRDs no longer declare the removed versions, not that etcd has been migrated

quote: ⚠ Following their deprecation in version 1.5, the cert-manager API versions v1alpha2, v1alpha3, and v1beta1 have been removed. You must ensure that all cert-manager custom resources are stored in etcd at version v1 and that all cert-manager `CustomResourceDefinition`s have only v1 as the stored version **before** upgrading. Please read [Migrating Deprecated API Resources] for full instructions.
remediation: Migrate stored resources to v1 (`cmctl upgrade migrate-api-version`, or re-apply every cert-manager resource) and make v1 the only version the CRDs declare, BEFORE upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("cert-manager\\.io$")) as $c | $c.status.storedVersions[] | select(. != "v1") | "\($c.metadata.name) still stores \(.)"'  # each row is a CRD whose etcd contents must be migrated to v1; NO rows = clean

title: HTTP-01 solver Ingresses go back to the kubernetes.io/ingress.class annotation

detection.reason: whether a solver uses an Ingress is projected; the class VALUE and which controller serves it are not

quote: If you are using Traefik, Istio, Ambassador, or ingress-nginx _and_ you are using a non-default value for the class (e.g., `istio-internal`), or if you experience any issues with your HTTP-01 challenges please read the [notes on Ingress v1 compatibility].
remediation: If the solver's class is a non-default value on Traefik, Istio, Ambassador or ingress-nginx, confirm the controller honours the `kubernetes.io/ingress.class` annotation, or set the solver's `ingressClassName` explicitly.
verifyCommand: kubectl get issuers,clusterissuers -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | . as $i | .spec.acme.solvers[]? | select(.http01.ingress.class) | "\($i.kind)/\($i.metadata.namespace // "cluster")/\($i.metadata.name) class=\(.http01.ingress.class)"'  # each row's class is applied as an annotation again from 1.7

title: Server-side-applied CRDs keep a cainjector managedFields entry that blocks the upgrade

detection.reason: managedFields are stripped from every collected object

quote: As part of the work to remove deprecated APIs cert-manager `CustomResourceDefinition`s no longer require a conversion webhook. The related change in cert-manager `CustomResourceDefinition` specs results in invalid `CustomResourceDefinition` configurations for users who are upgrading to cert-manager 1.7 using `kubectl apply --server-side=true -f <manifests>`.
remediation: Before applying the 1.7 CRDs with server-side apply, remove the `cainjector` entry from each cert-manager CRD's managedFields (the vendor's note carries the patch loop).
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json --show-managed-fields | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("cert-manager\\.io$")) | select([.metadata.managedFields[]?.manager] | index("cainjector")) | .metadata.name'  # each row still carries the cainjector entry; NO rows = clean
